question: Give NVIDIA's Data Center revenue for each quarter from Q2 FY2026 through Q2 FY2027 and the QoQ growth for each.
grading: Each quarterly value ±0.5% USD millions; QoQ ±0.5pp; fail if Compute & Networking segment figures substituted or quarters mislabeled
answer: Data Center market-platform revenue (USD millions) / calculated QoQ growth: Q2 FY2026: 41,096 / 5.0726%; Q3 FY2026: 51,215 / 24.6228%; Q4 FY2026: 62,314 / 21.6714%; Q1 FY2027: 75,246 / 20.7530%; Q2 FY2027: 89,023 / 18.3093%. Q2 FY2026 growth uses the Q1 FY2026 baseline of USD 39,112 million. These are Data Center figures, not Compute & Networking segment revenue. [G19-E1, G19-E2]

output.answer:
Here are NVIDIA’s reported Data Center segment revenues by quarter from Q2 FY2026 through Q2 FY2027, with quarter‑over‑quarter (QoQ) growth calculated from the prior quarter’s Data Center revenue:

| Quarter | Data Center Revenue | QoQ Growth |
|---------|---------------------|------------|
| **Q2 FY2026** | **$41.1B** | **+5.1%** |
| **Q3 FY2026** | **$51.2B** | **+24.6%** |
| **Q4 FY2026** | **$62.3B** | **+21.7%** |
| **Q1 FY2027** | **$75.2B** | **+20.8%** |
| **Q2 FY2027** | **$89.0B** | **+18.3%** |

**Notes & sources**
- FY2026 quarters run Feb 2025 – Jan 2026; FY2027 quarters run Feb 2026 – Jan 2027. Q2 FY2027 ended July 26, 2026.
- Q2–Q4 FY2026 and Q1 FY2027 Data Center figures come from NVIDIA’s recasted revenue‑by‑market‑platform table released with Q1 FY2027 results.  
  Source: [NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Revenue by Market Platform (PDF)](https://s201.q4cdn.com/141608511/files/doc_financials/2027/Q127/Rev_by_Mkt_Qtrly_Trend_Q127-NEW-v3.pdf)
- Q1 FY2027 Data Center is also broken out as $75.2B ($60.4B compute + $14.8B networking) in the earnings release.  
  Source: [NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 Earnings Release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027)
- Q2 FY2027 Data Center revenue of $89.0B is confirmed in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release and supporting coverage (~18% QoQ).  
  Sources: [NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Earnings Release](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-second-quarter-fiscal-2027), [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-q2-fy2027-earnings-revenue-210149949.html)

All figures are actual reported results; the slowdown in Q2 FY2026 (+5.1%) preceded a sharp reacceleration beginning in Q3 FY2026 as Blackwell‑based shipments ramped.
